reason_summary: Prompt asked to create a parallel legal / contract authority rule-pack, sector-pack, dictionary, or framework-mapping. KYE already governs contract-action authority via kye:rule-pack:legal-contract + kye:sector-pack:legal-contract + kye:dictionary:legal-contract, bound to the SRA Code of Conduct, UK GDPR Article 28, and UK contract-law reasonableness (UCTA 1977). A parallel pack is a §0 competing-systems violation; re-mapping the frameworks is a §70 violation. Refusing the parallel pack.
remediation_hint: Build the agent as a Governed Agent PRODUCT that RUNS the existing kye:rule-pack:legal-contract verdict under KYE authority, strictly contract-action governance (no overlap with the litigation-evidence-discovery pack). Add only the agent-product artefacts (§52 binding, principal, product row + fan-out, SKU, pricing, kye-legal-action-authority-agent ™, governed-agents.html entry) and BIND — never re-map — the existing frameworks via kye:rule-pack:legal-contract + kye:dictionary:legal-contract.
